description: list_models asks the live query for its supported Models (query.supportedModels(), which the sidecar writes back as a switchyard supported_models line); each becomes {id: value, display_name: displayName} in the CLI's order. The CLI's own "default" row is left out: it is Switchyard's Default, which passes no Model. Synthesised from the Agent SDK 0.3.300 message types (paired with Claude Code 2.1.300), not captured from a live run: replace with a capture made with SWITCHYARD_RECORD_DIR (see sidecar/README.md).
